info.title: StubHub International Marketplace API
info.description: StubHub International (IE) ticket marketplace API for sellers and partners. Provides endpoints for event catalog search, inventory/listing management, order tracking, sales fulfillment, venue configuration, and webhook subscriptions.

post.description: Authenticates a StubHub International user account through their application Client Token and Secret. Returns an access token and refresh token valid for 6 months.

401.description: Authentication failed - invalid client credentials or user credentials

get.description: Retrieves all active events in the catalog. Results are paginated at 500 per request. Includes concerts, sporting matches, festivals, and other ticketed events.
Returns the permitted stock types (ticket delivery methods) for a specific event.
Returns the current status of a specific event.
Searches the event catalog by city, keyword, or other criteria.
Searches for event locations/cities by name.
Searches for performers/artists by name.
Searches for event venues.
Retrieves seat trait information for a specific event.
Retrieves section and zone mapping for a specific event venue.
Searches available ticket inventory for a specific event on StubHub.

parameters.name: eventId
parameters.description: Event identifier to search listings for

post.description: Allows an authenticated seller to create a new ticket listing on StubHub.

get.description: Retrieves all listings for the authenticated seller.
Retrieves details of a single listing by its ID.

patch.description: Updates an existing listing's price, seats, traits, or other details.

get.description: Retrieves a comprehensive summary of all seller listings with pricing and status information.
Retrieves listings modified within the last 7 days.
Retrieves all orders for the authenticated seller.
Retrieves detailed information about a specific order including items, payment, and delivery details.
Retrieves all sales for the authenticated seller. Returns a maximum of 200 records.
Retrieves all sales for a specific event.
Retrieves a summary of sales across all events.
Retrieves all payment records for the seller's sales.

post.description: Confirms offline ticket delivery for a sale with a confirmation number.

put.description: Changes the delivery/stock type for a sale.

get.description: Retrieves details about a venue configuration including section maps and seating information.

post.description: Creates a new webhook subscription for listing_sale and listing_status events.

get.description: Retrieves all webhook subscriptions for the authenticated partner.
Retrieves a specific webhook subscription by ID.

bearerAuth.description: Bearer token obtained from the /sellers/oauth/accesstoken endpoint. Must be refreshed every 6 months.

basicAuth.description: Base64-encoded consumer key and secret separated by a colon. Used only for token generation.

numFound.description: Total number of events matching query

listing.description: Event types to subscribe to (listing_sale, listing_status)
